method: Independent static comparison of original source cohort/support/order/covariance arithmetic, mathematical derivative and source-message separation; no real packet evaluation, labels, fit, or repeated synthetic execution.

checks.derivative: For fixed support, statistic and peer likelihood, d E[y]/d eta=Cov(y,t)=Var(y)/max(gap-tau,60). Every finite difference keeps the same computed loglike and support arrays.
checks.zero_tilt: Original support moments, cohort memberships, calibration, covariance subtraction and loglike preserve original ordering; runtime requires touched/prior/IDs exact and posterior within original 1e-8 tolerance.
checks.source_derivative: Cov_prior(contribution,t)*x accumulated only over eligible supported targets; distinct counterfactual from target-only posterior map.
checks.source_rank: Unique source coordinate rows separate from repeated pair whitening. Full marginal source covariance held at zero tilt; not a stacked independent likelihood or Fisher information.
checks.numerical_rank: Centered and nuisance residual ranks now use original matrix thresholds; nuisance residual/original Frobenius norm is reported.
checks.provenance: Historical inputs, helpers, packet, retained inference, original input audit and proposal are hashed. Packet schema is explicit and label-free.
checks.scope: One thread, no optimizer, no noise fit, no model training; root must allocate real gate. Runtime limit checked at month boundaries, not a hard per-target interrupt.

limitations: This derivative is not the derivative of a jointly reconditioned posterior when every peer prior changes. Future training and prediction must keep the stated fixed-message construction, or account for additional derivatives and revalidate.

Feature centering within intersection pairs does not remove every separate taxi/delay source nuisance or airline/month direction. The reported three source-type biases are only three constant directions.
Nonzero rank is algebraic trainability, not predictive headroom, causal identifiability, unbiased source calibration or independent information.

Held packet priors are admissible for source-only diagnosis, but do not supply honest train-peer predictions. All 54 historically referenced inner prediction caches remain absent; no learner fit follows merely from gate success.
A later posterior-MSE versus prior-MSE screen needs matched initialization, training data, optimization and final-score transport, with source evidence used once.
